integrity: Finite scripts independently checked n=7..10 and n=7..9; analytic universal proof uses cited Hilton-Milner equality theorem and derives overlaps and paths. Independent external review not performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to labeled maximum nontrivial intersecting triple families for integers n>=7; simultaneous whole-triple batch moves and optimal endpoints. Equality classification credited to Hilton-Milner and Polcyn-Rucinski. No larger-uniformity or near-extremal claim. Some unindexed equivalent priority risk remains.
title: A linear exchange barrier and diameter-five mobility for Hilton–Milner triple-system extremizers
